summary: Ford Credit Auto Receivables Two LLC, as depositor, filed an 8-K reporting an Underwriting Agreement dated September 22, 2026 with BNP Paribas, Lloyds, RBC, BofA and Credit Agricole for Ford Credit Auto Owner Trust 2026-C's auto-loan ABS notes, described in a same-day Rule 424(b)(2) prospectus. The 8-K also includes Form SF-3 CEO certifications and substantially final transaction documents for filing on the closing date. This is a routine securitization shelf takedown, not a special situation; no stake, per-share price, premium or board recommendation is stated. Watch issuance spreads and pool performance.
